description: Research in background tabs, then borrow the user's tab through the toolbar popup; the user takes the tab back and closes the agent's tabs. Take back comes first: a handed-off tab counts as an agent tab, so Close agent tabs would close it too.
prompt: I'm reading this article about kitsune. In two background tabs, find out how Inari Ōkami and Fushimi Inari-taisha are linked to foxes. Then ask me for this tab and jump it to the part about how many tails a kitsune has. Answer in three short lines.
